items.title: Adrian Cunningham interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 31, 2021
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I’ll never forget Buddy DeFranco called the clarinet the “agony stick.” [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yes, I’ve heard worse than that too.

ctx.x: Awful. It was awful. It was hell. It still is hell, oh my God. Yeah. You know I think like anything if you love the sound of it, if the sound just pulls you in you just work through it and you just get over the frustrations you know, yeah.
I’ll never forget Buddy DeFranco called the clarinet the “agony stick.”
Oh yes, I’ve heard worse than that too. Indeed it is. © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-
